content:
Updated 8:45 p.m. ET: Proton's latest update states: "This outage is now largely resolved, with all services back online. However, we are still working through a small number of lingering issues, so some users may experience delays in sending and receiving email, as well as notification delays. No data was lost as a result of this outage." The original report follows below.

Proton confirms major outage affecting Proton Mail, Proton VPN, Lumo and other platforms and services. Here's what we know.

Proton is working to fix it

Earlier tonight, Proton's status page confirmed major outages for the following services:

  • Proton Mail
  • Proton VPN
  • Proton Calendar
  • Proton Drive
  • Proton Pass
  • SimpleLogin
  • Proton Wallet
  • Lumo by Proton

The company said after an initial investigation and mitigation, all issues are now listed as partial outages. A status update at 7:37 p.m. ET said:

The outage was first acknowledged at 6:09 p.m. ET when outage reports on Downdetector began to climb. Users on X also flagged issues, prompting a response from the company:

We are monitoring the issue and will update this post with new information or when it is marked resolved.
